purpose: Prevent a legitimate Studio or Titan Shopify buyer from being stranded while native ORDERS_PAID webhook registration is unavailable.

runner.action: For each connected-Shopify paid order in the lookback window, ignore unrelated products. For exact Studio/Titan line items, compute SHA-256 of the normalized checkout email locally, then invoke public.hercules_reconcile_verified_shopify_paid_order_v1 with only verified Shopify facts. Never infer payment state. Never alter pricing, legal approvals, checkout status, product status, or publication.

stopCondition: Disable this fallback after a verified native Shopify ORDERS_PAID webhook is registered and end-to-end entitlement delivery is proven.
